zh-Hans.description:
DeepReader 是原生 iPhone 和 iPad 文档阅读器，让上下文解释留在阅读页面。

边读边理解
长按选择词句，在半透明阅读助手中获得解释、继续追问。浮窗可拖动、收起或关闭，正文保持在原处。成功的回答保存在本机历史，方便回顾和分享。

调整阅读空间
宽屏可使用右侧 AI 栏，拖动分隔线调整正文和答案各自的空间，也可切换悬浮模式。窄屏自动使用浮窗；布局偏好保存在本机。

选择回答依据
可选择“仅书中内容”或“结合通用知识（不联网）”。后者可补充模型已有的背景知识，并区分原文与补充解释；不会执行网页搜索。

自己的阅读书库
从“文件”导入 PDF、EPUB、TXT 和 Markdown。支持搜索、高亮、阅读位置、评分和读完状态。PDF 可导出带高亮的副本；导入不会修改原文件。

按需总结
主动选择全文总结，提取文档文字并生成摘要。长文会分段处理。

使用前请了解
• 应用免费下载，本地阅读无需 API Key。
• AI 需要您自己的服务商 API Key，服务商可能收费，并设置额度及地区限制。应用不附送共享 Key 或无限免费 AI。
• 首次向接收方发送前说明数据范围并征求授权；授权绑定服务商及完整接口地址，记住后仅在点击 AI 操作时发送，可在设置中撤销。更换接收方需重新授权。
• 支持 DeepSeek、Gemini、Qwen、Kimi、GLM、Doubao、MiniMax、Grok、Mistral 的预设直连接口的文字对话模型；具体模型和服务可用性取决于您的账户及地区。
• 解释发送选文与语境，追问包含先前回答与问题，全文总结发送可提取全文。数据直接发送给所选服务商和接口地址。
• EPUB 暂以纯文本章节显示，不显示原书版式和图片；Markdown 显示源文本。电子书搜索限当前章节。
• 不支持 DRM、MOBI/AZW3、Kindle KFX、扫描文件 OCR 或跨设备同步。
• AI 回答可能出错，请结合原文核对。
• 支持中文和英文界面。

DeepReader 是独立项目，不是 SumatraPDF 或模型服务商 的官方产品。
zh-Hans.promotional_text: 阅读 PDF 和电子书，在悬浮框或可调侧栏中解释选文、继续追问。可选择仅书中内容或结合通用知识（不联网）。AI 使用自己的服务商 API Key，费用与额度另计。
zh-Hans.keywords: 阅读,电子书,文献,语境,笔记,高亮,书单,总结,PDF,EPUB

en-US.description:
DeepReader is a native iPhone and iPad document reader that keeps contextual explanations beside your reading.

Understand as you read
Touch and hold to select words or sentences. Explain and ask follow-up questions in a translucent assistant that you can drag, collapse or close without leaving the document. Successful answers stay in local History for review and sharing.

Adjust your reading space
On wide screens, use a right AI sidebar and drag its divider to resize the document and answer areas, or switch to floating mode. Narrow screens use the floating panel automatically. Layout preferences are saved locally.

Choose the answer scope
Choose Book only or General knowledge (no browsing). General knowledge can add background already learned by the model and distinguishes it from the source; it does not search the web.

Your own reading library
Import PDF, EPUB, TXT and Markdown from Files. Search, highlight, remember reading positions, rate books and mark them finished. Export highlighted PDF copies. Importing preserves your original files.

Summarize on demand
Choose a full-document summary to extract and summarize text. Long documents are processed in sections.

Before you begin
• Free download; local reading needs no API key.
• AI requires your own provider API key. Provider fees, quotas and regional restrictions may apply. No shared key or unlimited free AI is included.
• First-use disclosure asks for sharing permission for the provider and full endpoint. Remembered permission applies only when you tap an AI action, can be revoked in Settings, and does not apply to a new recipient.
• Supports text chat models through preset direct endpoints for DeepSeek, Gemini, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, Doubao, MiniMax, Grok and Mistral. Model and service availability depend on your account and region.
• Explanations send the selection and context; follow-ups add the previous answer and question; summaries send extractable full text directly to the selected provider and endpoint.
• EPUB displays chapter text without original layout or images. Markdown displays source text. Ebook search covers the current chapter.
• DRM, MOBI/AZW3, Kindle KFX, scanned-document OCR and cross-device sync are unsupported.
• AI answers may be inaccurate. Check the source.
• Chinese and English interfaces are included.

DeepReader is an independent project, not an official product of SumatraPDF or the model providers.
en-US.promotional_text: Read with a floating assistant or resizable sidebar. Choose book-only answers or general knowledge without browsing. AI uses your own API key; provider fees apply.
